end.summary:
Practised estimating a large collection using groups of ten as a guide.
Worked with examples involving 3 and 4 groups and an estimate of about 30–40.
An initial response counted the groups as single objects.
Later responses used “das, bees, tees” and gave an estimate of around 30; the group-counting mix-up was not fully corrected.
end.parentNote: Asha practised using a known group of ten to estimate a larger collection without counting every object. Ananya used the tens sequence and said “around 30” near the end; earlier, they counted the number of groups as the total, and this mix-up was not fully corrected. At home, show a small collection arranged in groups of ten and ask, “How many groups? About how many objects?”
